entries.description: Authorised 4-tier Row-Level Security view over operational events, task executions, and daily huddle metrics.
entries.overview:
# Authorised Operations View (`v_operations`)

## Purpose & Grain
- **Grain:** One row per operational event or activity (`operation_id`).
- **Authorised View:** Enforces 4-tier `SESSION_USER()` Row-Level Security via `user_entitlements`.
- **Snapshot Anchor Date:** Evaluates relative dates against snapshot anchor (`2026-10-17`).

## Mandatory Join Rules
- Join to Department: `LEFT JOIN department d ON v_operations.department_id = d.department_id`.
- Join to Customer Bridge: `LEFT JOIN customer_bridge c ON v_operations.customer_id = c.customer_id`.

queries.description: Daily Operational Summary and KPI Volume by Department
queries.sql: SELECT department_id, COUNT(operation_id) AS total_operations, ROUND(SUM(operational_volume), 2) AS total_volume FROM `enterprise-agent-project.enterprise_analytics.v_operations` WHERE status != 'CANCELLED' AND operation_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-01' AND DATE '2026-10-17' GROUP BY department_id ORDER BY total_volume DESC

entries.description: Authorised view over product catalog, pricing tiers, and inventory availability.
entries.overview:
# Authorised Catalog View (`v_catalog_enriched`)

## Purpose & Grain
- **Grain:** One row per product offering (`item_id`).
- **Usage:** Used by Pillar 2 Catalog & Personalisation Agent for product positioning and customer matching.

queries.description: Active Offerings by Category and Margin Tier
queries.sql: SELECT category, margin_tier, COUNT(item_id) AS item_count, ROUND(AVG(unit_price), 2) AS avg_price FROM `enterprise-agent-project.enterprise_analytics.v_catalog_enriched` WHERE is_active = TRUE GROUP BY category, margin_tier ORDER BY item_count DESC

schema_fields.name: is_active
schema_fields.description: Whether the offering is currently active

entries.description: Authorised view over commercial transactions, gross revenue, net margin, and settled payments.
entries.overview:
# Authorised Finance Transactions View (`v_finance_transactions`)

## Purpose & Grain
- **Grain:** One row per financial transaction (`transaction_id`).
- **Governance:** Subject to sensitive remuneration guardrails: individual personal commission and payroll are excluded.

queries.description: Monthly Financial Revenue and Margin Breakdown
queries.sql: SELECT transaction_type, COUNT(transaction_id) AS transaction_count, ROUND(SUM(gross_revenue), 2) AS total_gross_revenue, ROUND(SUM(net_margin), 2) AS total_net_margin FROM `enterprise-agent-project.enterprise_analytics.v_finance_transactions` WHERE status = 'SETTLED' GROUP BY transaction_type ORDER BY total_gross_revenue DESC
